control_statement: A high-confidence access-infrastructure inflection is present, while the canonical precursor record explicitly claims zero discovery events and no discovery cluster.
falsification_use: Prevents the TIDC analysis from treating technology availability or access alone as a discovery event. Any model that predicts a discovery event solely from this access inflection should fail this control unless later independently verifiable downstream results are separately coded.
inclusion_reason: The existing precursor ledger was intentionally designed to separate access from discovery, making this a direct negative control for availability-equals-output inflation.
limitations: This control does not assert that no downstream discovery will ever occur.
The control is anchored to the current evidence window and must be revisited if independently verifiable downstream results are later identified.
Institutional launch announcements do not establish longitudinal usage or research impact.
